notes_for_editor: Thin record: three facts (1910 log cabin with roof platform, USFS, registered 2010) plus a gone status. The story is about 125 words, at the low end of the 120-450 range, because the sources say nothing more about the site; the nomination and elevation sentences are the only additions beyond the cabin. The brief's record has no built event, and this research adds one for 1910. The brief's 'ground' kind is confirmed by the Forest Fire Lookout Association list (cite 4), not by the register page. Not checked: the Forest Service's own records for the cabin's removal date.
